actions.command:
cat << 'EOF' > create_chart.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data
category_names = ['Football', 'Volleyball', 'Basketball', 'Formula 1', 'Tennis']
results = {
    'USA': [12, 13, 15, 34, 28],
    'UK': [22, 26, 32, 12, 10],
    'Germany': [31, 32, 15, 6, 20],
    'Spain': [30, 13, 11, 12, 35],
    'China': [25, 24, 8, 3, 43],
    'Italy': [18, 9, 15, 25, 30]
}

# Convert results to a numpy array for easier manipulation
data = np.array(list(results.values()))

# Create figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Define colors using RdYlGn colormap
category_colors = plt.colormaps['RdYlGn'](np.linspace(0.15, 0.85, len(category_names)))

# Plot stacked bars
bottom = np.zeros(data.shape[0])
for i, (category, color) in enumerate(zip(category_names, category_colors)):
    ax.barh(results.keys(), data[:, i], left=bottom, label=category, color=color)
    bottom += data[:, i]

# Add labels and title
ax.set_title('Favorite Sports by Country', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Number of Responses')
ax.set_ylabel('Country')
ax.legend(loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(1.2, 1))

# Add value labels on the bars
for i, country in enumerate(results.keys()):
    bottom = 0
    for j, category in enumerate(category_names):
        height = data[i, j]
        ax.text(bottom + height / 2, i, str(height),
                ha='center', va='center', color='white', fontsize=10)
        bottom += height

# Save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('figure.png')
plt.close()
EOF
